author.name: Reliability Ruth
author.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I am willing to drop canary testing from the current sprint entirely. We can leave that mechanism untouched and off the roadmap for now. In exchange, I need the shadow deployment environment to be fully automated and governed before we touch the live forecast. If we do not secure that isolation, the risk to the morning order window is too high. I accept losing the gradual rollout capability for the next promotion week to ensure the new model does not break the pipeline. My priority is a clean, auditable shadow run that proves the system is safe before any real money is committed.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to drop canary testing and accept losing gradual rollout capabilities in exchange for a fully automated and governed shadow deployment environment.
